import subprocess, os

# Search for files whose name mentions counter/replica/serve, plus any executable scripts
cmds = [
    "find / -xdev -iname '*counter*' 2>/dev/null | head -50",
    "find / -xdev -iname '*replica*' 2>/dev/null | head -50",
    "find / -xdev -iname '*counter*cli*' 2>/dev/null | head -20",
]
for c in cmds:
    print("="*70)
    print("$", c)
    r = subprocess.run(c, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout[:3000] or "(no matches)")
    if r.stderr.strip():
        print("ERR:", r.stderr[:500])
